verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents registrable custom webhooks that POST JSON payloads to any endpoint, with customizable templates, variables and Go functions. However, the only documented events are Trigger alerts and SLO burn alerts, not a broader event-subscription model. missing for 10: webhook subscriptions for event types beyond alerts (e.g. resource changes, markers, query or board events), API-based webhook registration, delivery and retry or signature guarantees, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Route Honeycomb Trigger and SLO burn alerts to any service that accepts a JSON payload, including third-party tools and custom integrations.
Once configured, Honeycomb sends JSON payloads to your webhook upon alerts firing.
This allows you to build custom integrations that receive JSON payloads from Honeycomb upon alerts firing.
Use variables to customize payloads for your Honeycomb trigger alerts and SLO burn alerts.
Transform JSON template data in your Honeycomb webhook payloads using Go template functions to format, filter, and restructure alert content before delivery.
